changelog:
✨ New Features
  1.49.0-dev.8
  • Downloads: Add download item to the Shorts menu
  • Add Niconico-style live/replay comments
  • Downloads: Add playlist downloads for accounts without Premium
  • Channel search: Search the posts of the channel

  1.49.0-dev.7
  • Playback speed: Add playback speed to the Shorts player menu
  • Add Download post images patch
  • Show a warning when changing 'Navigation bar style' or turning on 'Enable tablet layout in player'

  1.49.0-dev.6
  • Media notification controls: Add options to seek with Previous & Next buttons
  • Add to queue: Add "Native queue" setting
  • Downloads: Add "Quick download on tap" setting
  • Navigation bar: Add "Navigation bar style" setting

🐛 Bug Fixes
  1.49.0-dev.8
  • Return YouTube Dislike: Feed thumbnail like count is not shown with the Classic feed card layout
  • Channel whitelists: Flyout menu opens with a delay while the channel is fetched
  • Litho filter: Crash when scrolling a list after a filtered element is removed
  • Playback speed: Use the bold icon for the Shorts player menu item
  • Premium-style queue: Fix missing titles and stale now playing row
  • Premium-style queue: Play the queue when the player Next button is pressed
  • Player icon style: Add Ionicons picture in picture button icon

  1.49.0-dev.7
  • Add to queue: Fix native queue on experimental versions
  • Litho filter: Filtered elements leave empty cells in the related videos grid of the tablet layout
  • Miniplayer: Related videos lists show a black frame after exiting fullscreen and scroll down
  • Add to queue: Native queue index errors crash before Android 13
  • Add to queue: Feed below the player stutters while scrolling
  • Minimal miniplayer: Video title and channel are missing after going back from the Shorts player
  • Video quality: Shorts quality selected in the menu is not kept and is used for the next Shorts
  • Disable playlist autoplay: fix looping the current video
  • Captions: Old caption stays on screen after SponsorBlock skips
  • Force fullscreen landscape: Screen rotates before the fullscreen gesture completes
  • Search comments: Search button is not shown in the Shorts comments and is shown in other panels
  • Litho filter: Filtered elements leave empty cells in the tablet layout grids
  • Video quality: Shorts quality menu sets another quality than the one selected
  • Minimal miniplayer: Bar is partly covered by the keyboard with the default navigation bar style

  1.49.0-dev.6
  • Hide layout components: Fix actions blocked by Hide Snackbar
  • Playback speed: Channel speed whitelist is not applied to preloaded Shorts
  • Captions: Captions not shown in picture-in-picture on 21.16 - 21.28
